findings.issue: Admin role references still present in UI components despite requirement to remove all admin/super admin functionality. BADGE_STYLES in AppHeader.jsx contains 'Super Admin' and 'Admin' badge definitions. isAdmin() function in AuthContext.jsx still checks for 'Admin' and 'Super Admin' roles. If any user account has access_type set to these values (through legacy data or manipulation), the UI will recognize and potentially enable admin functionality.
findings.correction: Remove 'Super Admin' and 'Admin' entries from BADGE_STYLES object in AppHeader.jsx (keep only 'User'). Update isAdmin() function in AuthContext.jsx to return false, or remove it entirely if no admin functionality remains in the codebase.
